title: Agent Substrate
description: Health of the Agent Substrate control plane: actors, workers, snapshots, router and API. Counts over long time ranges are sampled more coarsely and can be a few percent low.

panels.title: Ready workers
panels.description: Worker pods that are ready, for all pools. All atespaces.

targets.expr: sum(max by (ate_workerpool_namespace, ate_workerpool_name)(ate_workerpool_ready_workers))

panels.title: Missing workers
panels.description: Desired workers that are not ready. Above 0 for more than some minutes means a pool cannot start its pods. All atespaces.

targets.expr: sum(max by (ate_workerpool_namespace, ate_workerpool_name)(ate_workerpool_desired_workers)) - sum(max by (ate_workerpool_namespace, ate_workerpool_name)(ate_workerpool_ready_workers))

panels.title: Actor resumes
panels.description: Resume operations in the time range, with and without an error.

targets.expr: sum((((increase((max without (job, endpoint, container, service) (ate_actor_lifecycle_operation_duration_seconds_count{ate_template_atespace=~"$atespace",ate_actor_operation_name="resume"}))[$__range:$step]) or (max without (job, endpoint, container, service) (ate_actor_lifecycle_operation_duration_seconds_count{ate_template_atespace=~"$atespace",ate_actor_operation_name="resume"}) * 0)) + (min_over_time((max without (job, endpoint, container, service) (ate_actor_lifecycle_operation_duration_seconds_count{ate_template_atespace=~"$atespace",ate_actor_operation_name="resume"}))[$__range:$step]) unless max without (job, endpoint, container, service) (ate_actor_lifecycle_operation_duration_seconds_count{ate_template_atespace=~"$atespace",ate_actor_operation_name="resume"} offset $__range))) or increase((max without (job, endpoint, container, service) (ate_actor_lifecycle_operation_duration_seconds_count{ate_template_atespace=~"$atespace",ate_actor_operation_name="resume"}))[$__range:$step]))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Resume time, p95
panels.description: 95th percentile of the successful resume operations in the time range. An estimate from histogram buckets.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le)((((increase((max without (job, endpoint, container, service) (ate_actor_lifecycle_operation_duration_seconds_bucket{ate_template_atespace=~"$atespace",ate_actor_operation_name="resume",error_type=""}))[$__range:$step]) or (max without (job, endpoint, container, service) (ate_actor_lifecycle_operation_duration_seconds_bucket{ate_template_atespace=~"$atespace",ate_actor_operation_name="resume",error_type=""}) * 0)) + (min_over_time((max without (job, endpoint, container, service) (ate_actor_lifecycle_operation_duration_seconds_bucket{ate_template_atespace=~"$atespace",ate_actor_operation_name="resume",error_type=""}))[$__range:$step]) unless max without (job, endpoint, container, service) (ate_actor_lifecycle_operation_duration_seconds_bucket{ate_template_atespace=~"$atespace",ate_actor_operation_name="resume",error_type=""} offset $__range))) or increase((max without (job, endpoint, container, service) (ate_actor_lifecycle_operation_duration_seconds_bucket{ate_template_atespace=~"$atespace",ate_actor_operation_name="resume",error_type=""}))[$__range:$step]))))

panels.title: Failed operations
panels.description: Actor lifecycle operations that ended with an error in the time range.

targets.expr: sum((((increase((max without (job, endpoint, container, service) (ate_actor_lifecycle_operation_duration_seconds_count{ate_template_atespace=~"$atespace",error_type!=""}))[$__range:$step]) or (max without (job, endpoint, container, service) (ate_actor_lifecycle_operation_duration_seconds_count{ate_template_atespace=~"$atespace",error_type!=""}) * 0)) + (min_over_time((max without (job, endpoint, container, service) (ate_actor_lifecycle_operation_duration_seconds_count{ate_template_atespace=~"$atespace",error_type!=""}))[$__range:$step]) unless max without (job, endpoint, container, service) (ate_actor_lifecycle_operation_duration_seconds_count{ate_template_atespace=~"$atespace",error_type!=""} offset $__range))) or increase((max without (job, endpoint, container, service) (ate_actor_lifecycle_operation_duration_seconds_count{ate_template_atespace=~"$atespace",error_type!=""}))[$__range:$step]))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Actor crashes
panels.description: Actors that crashed in the time range.

targets.expr: sum((((increase((max without (job, endpoint, container, service) (ate_actor_crashes_total{ate_template_atespace=~"$atespace"}))[$__range:$step]) or (max without (job, endpoint, container, service) (ate_actor_crashes_total{ate_template_atespace=~"$atespace"}) * 0)) + (min_over_time((max without (job, endpoint, container, service) (ate_actor_crashes_total{ate_template_atespace=~"$atespace"}))[$__range:$step]) unless max without (job, endpoint, container, service) (ate_actor_crashes_total{ate_template_atespace=~"$atespace"} offset $__range))) or increase((max without (job, endpoint, container, service) (ate_actor_crashes_total{ate_template_atespace=~"$atespace"}))[$__range:$step]))) or vector(0)

panels.title: API server errors
panels.description: gRPC calls to the API server that ended with a server error code, in the time range. All atespaces.

targets.expr: sum((((increase((max without (job, endpoint, container, service) (rpc_server_call_duration_seconds_count{app="ate-api-server",rpc_response_status_code=~"UNKNOWN|DEADLINE_EXCEEDED|RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED|INTERNAL|UNAVAILABLE|DATA_LOSS"}))[$__range:$step]) or (max without (job, endpoint, container, service) (rpc_server_call_duration_seconds_count{app="ate-api-server",rpc_response_status_code=~"UNKNOWN|DEADLINE_EXCEEDED|RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED|INTERNAL|UNAVAILABLE|DATA_LOSS"}) * 0)) + (min_over_time((max without (job, endpoint, container, service) (rpc_server_call_duration_seconds_count{app="ate-api-server",rpc_response_status_code=~"UNKNOWN|DEADLINE_EXCEEDED|RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED|INTERNAL|UNAVAILABLE|DATA_LOSS"}))[$__range:$step]) unless max without (job, endpoint, container, service) (rpc_server_call_duration_seconds_count{app="ate-api-server",rpc_response_status_code=~"UNKNOWN|DEADLINE_EXCEEDED|RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED|INTERNAL|UNAVAILABLE|DATA_LOSS"} offset $__range))) or increase((max without (job, endpoint, container, service) (rpc_server_call_duration_seconds_count{app="ate-api-server",rpc_response_status_code=~"UNKNOWN|DEADLINE_EXCEEDED|RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED|INTERNAL|UNAVAILABLE|DATA_LOSS"}))[$__range:$step]))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Targets down
panels.description: Control plane pods that Prometheus cannot scrape now. While a target is down, the other panels miss its data. All atespaces.

targets.expr: sum(up{namespace="ate-system", app=~"ate-api-server|ate-controller|atelet|atenet-router|atenet-egress"} == bool 0)

panels.title: Operations
panels.description: Lifecycle operations that ended, by operation. A bar covers one step, so bars get taller when you zoom out.

targets.expr: sum by (ate_actor_operation_name)((((max without (job, endpoint, container, service) (ate_actor_lifecycle_operation_duration_seconds_count{ate_template_atespace=~"$atespace"}) - max without (job, endpoint, container, service) (ate_actor_lifecycle_operation_duration_seconds_count{ate_template_atespace=~"$atespace"} offset $__interval)) >= 0) or (max without (job, endpoint, container, service) (ate_actor_lifecycle_operation_duration_seconds_count{ate_template_atespace=~"$atespace"}) unless max without (job, endpoint, container, service) (ate_actor_lifecycle_operation_duration_seconds_count{ate_template_atespace=~"$atespace"} offset $__interval)) or (max without (job, endpoint, container, service) (ate_actor_lifecycle_operation_duration_seconds_count{ate_template_atespace=~"$atespace"}) < max without (job, endpoint, container, service) (ate_actor_lifecycle_operation_duration_seconds_count{ate_template_atespace=~"$atespace"} offset $__interval)))) > 0

panels.title: Failed operations, by operation and error
panels.description: An empty panel is good. ResourceExhausted means that no worker had room.

targets.expr: sum by (ate_actor_operation_name, error_type)((((max without (job, endpoint, container, service) (ate_actor_lifecycle_operation_duration_seconds_count{ate_template_atespace=~"$atespace",error_type!=""}) - max without (job, endpoint, container, service) (ate_actor_lifecycle_operation_duration_seconds_count{ate_template_atespace=~"$atespace",error_type!=""} offset $__interval)) >= 0) or (max without (job, endpoint, container, service) (ate_actor_lifecycle_operation_duration_seconds_count{ate_template_atespace=~"$atespace",error_type!=""}) unless max without (job, endpoint, container, service) (ate_actor_lifecycle_operation_duration_seconds_count{ate_template_atespace=~"$atespace",error_type!=""} offset $__interval)) or (max without (job, endpoint, container, service) (ate_actor_lifecycle_operation_duration_seconds_count{ate_template_atespace=~"$atespace",error_type!=""}) < max without (job, endpoint, container, service) (ate_actor_lifecycle_operation_duration_seconds_count{ate_template_atespace=~"$atespace",error_type!=""} offset $__interval)))) > 0

defaults.noValue: No failed operation in this range

panels.title: Placement results
panels.description: Results of the scheduler when it looks for a worker. no_capacity means that the pool is full. All atespaces.

targets.expr: sum by (ate_scheduler_outcome)((((max without (job, endpoint, container, service) (ate_scheduler_assignment_duration_seconds_count) - max without (job, endpoint, container, service) (ate_scheduler_assignment_duration_seconds_count offset $__interval)) >= 0) or (max without (job, endpoint, container, service) (ate_scheduler_assignment_duration_seconds_count) unless max without (job, endpoint, container, service) (ate_scheduler_assignment_duration_seconds_count offset $__interval)) or (max without (job, endpoint, container, service) (ate_scheduler_assignment_duration_seconds_count) < max without (job, endpoint, container, service) (ate_scheduler_assignment_duration_seconds_count offset $__interval)))) > 0

panels.title: Workers by state
panels.description: idle has no actor. partial runs actors and has room. at_capacity is full. unschedulable cannot take an actor. All atespaces.

targets.expr: sum by (ate_worker_state)(avg by (ate_workerpool_namespace, ate_workerpool_name, ate_sandbox_class, ate_worker_state)(ate_workerpool_workers))

panels.title: CPU of the actors, by atespace
panels.description: CPU cores that the actor sandboxes use.

targets.expr: sum by (ate_template_atespace)(rate(ate_actor_stats_cpu_time_seconds_total{ate_template_atespace=~"$atespace"}[$__rate_interval]))

defaults.noValue: No actor ran in this range

panels.title: Snapshot size, by file
panels.description: Average size of each snapshot file in the time range. Large files make suspend and resume slow.

targets.expr: sum by (file_name)((((increase((max without (job, endpoint, container, service) (atelet_snapshot_size_bytes_sum{ate_template_atespace=~"$atespace"}))[$__range:$step]) or (max without (job, endpoint, container, service) (atelet_snapshot_size_bytes_sum{ate_template_atespace=~"$atespace"}) * 0)) + (min_over_time((max without (job, endpoint, container, service) (atelet_snapshot_size_bytes_sum{ate_template_atespace=~"$atespace"}))[$__range:$step]) unless max without (job, endpoint, container, service) (atelet_snapshot_size_bytes_sum{ate_template_atespace=~"$atespace"} offset $__range))) or increase((max without (job, endpoint, container, service) (atelet_snapshot_size_bytes_sum{ate_template_atespace=~"$atespace"}))[$__range:$step]))) / (sum by (file_name)((((increase((max without (job, endpoint, container, service) (atelet_snapshot_size_bytes_count{ate_template_atespace=~"$atespace"}))[$__range:$step]) or (max without (job, endpoint, container, service) (atelet_snapshot_size_bytes_count{ate_template_atespace=~"$atespace"}) * 0)) + (min_over_time((max without (job, endpoint, container, service) (atelet_snapshot_size_bytes_count{ate_template_atespace=~"$atespace"}))[$__range:$step]) unless max without (job, endpoint, container, service) (atelet_snapshot_size_bytes_count{ate_template_atespace=~"$atespace"} offset $__range))) or increase((max without (job, endpoint, container, service) (atelet_snapshot_size_bytes_count{ate_template_atespace=~"$atespace"}))[$__range:$step]))) > 0)

panels.title: Late snapshot uploads
panels.description: Actors whose snapshot is not in the store yet, by how late the upload is. A long time above 0 means a slow or unreachable store. All atespaces.

targets.expr: sum by (ate_snapshot_upload_overdue_band)(atelet_snapshot_upload_overdue_actors)

panels.title: Oldest snapshot not stored yet
panels.description: Age of the oldest snapshot that is only on a node. If the node is lost, that state is lost. All atespaces.

targets.expr: max(atelet_snapshot_undurable_age_max_seconds)

panels.title: Parked requests
panels.description: Requests that wait in the router until an actor is ready. All atespaces.

targets.expr: sum(atenet_router_parking_active)

panels.title: Egress requests per second, by response class
panels.description: Requests from actors that leave through the egress gateway. 5xx can mean that a target or the gateway fails. All atespaces.

defaults.noValue: No egress request in this range

panels.title: Egress requests in progress
panels.description: Requests that the egress gateway handles now. All atespaces.

targets.expr: sum(envoy_http_downstream_rq_active{app="atenet-egress",envoy_http_conn_manager_prefix=~"mitm_.*"})

panels.title: Calls per second, by method
panels.description: Rate of the gRPC calls that the API server handles. All atespaces.

targets.expr: label_replace(sum by (rpc_method)(rate(rpc_server_call_duration_seconds_count{app="ate-api-server",rpc_method=~"substrate.*"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0, "method", "$1", "rpc_method", ".*/(.*)")

panels.title: Calls that did not return OK, by code
panels.description: NOT_FOUND and FAILED_PRECONDITION can be normal, for example from a client that reads before it creates. All atespaces.

targets.expr: sum by (rpc_response_status_code)((((max without (job, endpoint, container, service) (rpc_server_call_duration_seconds_count{app="ate-api-server",rpc_method=~"substrate.*",rpc_response_status_code!="OK"}) - max without (job, endpoint, container, service) (rpc_server_call_duration_seconds_count{app="ate-api-server",rpc_method=~"substrate.*",rpc_response_status_code!="OK"} offset $__interval)) >= 0) or (max without (job, endpoint, container, service) (rpc_server_call_duration_seconds_count{app="ate-api-server",rpc_method=~"substrate.*",rpc_response_status_code!="OK"}) unless max without (job, endpoint, container, service) (rpc_server_call_duration_seconds_count{app="ate-api-server",rpc_method=~"substrate.*",rpc_response_status_code!="OK"} offset $__interval)) or (max without (job, endpoint, container, service) (rpc_server_call_duration_seconds_count{app="ate-api-server",rpc_method=~"substrate.*",rpc_response_status_code!="OK"}) < max without (job, endpoint, container, service) (rpc_server_call_duration_seconds_count{app="ate-api-server",rpc_method=~"substrate.*",rpc_response_status_code!="OK"} offset $__interval)))) > 0

panels.title: Call time, p95, by method
panels.description: 95th percentile of the call time. All atespaces.

targets.expr: label_replace(histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, rpc_method)(rate(rpc_server_call_duration_seconds_bucket{app="ate-api-server",rpc_method=~"substrate.*"}[$__rate_interval]))) > 0, "method", "$1", "rpc_method", ".*/(.*)")
